precondition: Test build of backend + frontend; role accounts supplied by QA lead; a controlled inbox for Guest invitations; Postman or curl.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login signs in an active account and starts a session.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "<Secretary email>", "password": "<Secretary password>" }
Send GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken from step 1>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.

Body has "accessToken", "accessTokenExpiresAt" (about 15 minutes ahead) and "user": { "id", "email", "fullName", "roleId", "roleName", "capabilities": [...] }; "roleName" and "capabilities" match the account's role in the role matrix (UC-11).
Set-Cookie: tc_refresh_token=...; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/auth; Max-Age=604800 (7 days).
Body has no "refreshToken", no password and no password hash.
Step 2: HTTP 200 with the same user.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login rejects a wrong password.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "<Secretary email>", "password": "SaiMatKhau@2026" }
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Body: { "code": "MSG01", "message": "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng." }
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login answers an unknown email exactly like a wrong password.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "khongtontai@trustcabinet.local", "password": "SaiMatKhau@2026" }
Compare status and body with the previous case.
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Body: { "code": "MSG01", "message": "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng." } — identical to a wrong password, so the answer does not reveal whether the email has an account.
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
No account uses the email "khongtontai@trustcabinet.local".

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login rejects empty credentials.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "", "password": "" }
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Body: { "code": "MSG01", "message": "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng." }
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
cases.note: UC-01 | Manual only (empty input takes the MSG01 branch)

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login refuses a deactivated account given the right password.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "<deactivated email>", "password": "<its password>" }
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Body: { "code": "MSG02", "message": "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." }
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A password account deactivated by the Admin (UC-06c), supplied by QA lead with its password.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login does not reveal a deactivated account to a wrong password.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "<deactivated email>", "password": "SaiMatKhau@2026" }
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, body code "MSG01" — not MSG02: the password is checked before the account status, so only someone who knows the password learns that the account is deactivated.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Same deactivated account as the previous case.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login signs in an account whose role grants no capability.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "<Member email>", "password": "<Member password>" }
expected: HTTP 200 OK with "accessToken" and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
"user.capabilities" = [] (attending, reading and voting need no capability).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active account whose role grants no capability (e.g. Member), supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login blocks the 6th attempt for one email within a minute, even with the right password.
procedure: Within one minute send POST /api/auth/login 5 times for the Secretary email with password "SaiMatKhau@2026".
Within the same minute send a 6th request with the correct password.
expected: Requests 1–5: HTTP 401, code "MSG01".
Request 6: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, header Retry-After (seconds), body { "code": "MSG414", "message": "Bạn đã thử quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút." }.
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set: a correct guess during the lockout is not revealed.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Sign-in rate limits at their defaults (test server): 5 attempts per minute per email, 60 per minute per IP.
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/login works again once the limit window has passed.
procedure: Repeat the previous case until HTTP 429.
Wait the number of seconds given in Retry-After.
Send POST /api/auth/login with the correct Secretary credentials.
expected: Step 3: HTTP 200 OK with "accessToken" and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Sign-in rate limits at their defaults (test server): 5 attempts per minute per email, 60 per minute per IP.
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify the per-IP limit is shared by /login, /google and /password-reset.
procedure: From one machine, within one minute, send 60 requests in total spread over POST /api/auth/login (different emails), POST /api/auth/google and POST /api/auth/password-reset.
Send a 61st request to any of the three.
expected: Requests 1–60: their normal answers (401, 400...).
Request 61: HTTP 429, header Retry-After, body code "MSG414".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Sign-in rate limits at their defaults (test server): 5 attempts per minute per email, 60 per minute per IP.
Run from a network address no other tester uses during that minute.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google signs in a linked active account with the same response as password sign-in.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "idToken": "<Google ID token>" }
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body has "accessToken", "accessTokenExpiresAt" and "user": { "id", "email", "fullName", "roleId", "roleName", "capabilities": [...] } — same shape as POST /api/auth/login.
Set-Cookie: tc_refresh_token=... (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/auth).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Google sign-in enabled on the build (Authentication:Google:Enabled = true).
Active account already linked to the tester's Gmail (has signed in with Google before).
A fresh Google ID token for that Gmail, captured from the "Tiếp tục với Google" button on /login (DevTools > Network > POST /api/auth/google > request body "idToken"), used within 1 hour.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google links an account at its first Google sign-in by verified email.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google with { "idToken": "<ID token of that Gmail>" }.
Later, sign in with Google again using a new ID token of the same Gmail.
As Admin, open the audit log (UC-13) and filter by the account.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 200 OK with a session for the account the Admin created.
Step 2: HTTP 200 OK.
Step 3: one "user.google_linked" entry for the account.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Google sign-in enabled on the build (Authentication:Google:Enabled = true).
The Admin has created an active account with the tester's Gmail as its email (UC-06a); it has never signed in with Google.
A fresh Google ID token for that Gmail, captured from the "Tiếp tục với Google" button on /login (DevTools > Network > POST /api/auth/google > request body "idToken"), used within 1 hour.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google rejects an ID token that cannot be verified.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google with { "idToken": "a.b.c" }.
Repeat with an ID token older than 1 hour.
expected: Both: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, body { "code": "MSG03", "message": "Đăng nhập bằng Google không thành công." } — never HTTP 500.
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Google sign-in enabled on the build (Authentication:Google:Enabled = true).

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google refuses a Google account that has no TrustCabinet account.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google with { "idToken": "<ID token of that Gmail>" }.
As Admin, search the user list (UC-05) for that Gmail.
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, body { "code": "MSG05", "message": "Tài khoản Google này chưa được cấp quyền truy cập hệ thống." }.
No cookie is set and no account is created: the Gmail is not in the user list.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Google sign-in enabled on the build (Authentication:Google:Enabled = true).
A Gmail that no TrustCabinet account uses.
A fresh Google ID token for that Gmail, captured from the "Tiếp tục với Google" button on /login (DevTools > Network > POST /api/auth/google > request body "idToken"), used within 1 hour.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google refuses a linked account that has been deactivated.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google with { "idToken": "<ID token of that Gmail>" }.
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, body { "code": "MSG02", "message": "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." }.
No tc_refresh_token cookie is set.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Google sign-in enabled on the build (Authentication:Google:Enabled = true).
An account linked to the tester's Gmail, then deactivated by the Admin (UC-06c).
A fresh Google ID token for that Gmail, captured from the "Tiếp tục với Google" button on /login (DevTools > Network > POST /api/auth/google > request body "idToken"), used within 1 hour.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google answers MSG02, not MSG05, for an account deactivated before its first Google sign-in.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google with { "idToken": "<ID token of that Gmail>" }.
Have the Admin reactivate the account, then sign in with Google again with a new ID token.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 401, body code "MSG02"; the account is not linked.
Step 2: HTTP 200 OK — the account links at this first successful sign-in.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Google sign-in enabled on the build (Authentication:Google:Enabled = true).
An account created with the tester's Gmail, never signed in with Google, then deactivated.
A fresh Google ID token for that Gmail, captured from the "Tiếp tục với Google" button on /login (DevTools > Network > POST /api/auth/google > request body "idToken"), used within 1 hour.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/google does not exist when Google sign-in is switched off.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/google with { "idToken": "a.b.c" }.
Send POST /api/auth/login with the Secretary credentials.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 404 Not Found, no message code — the route looks like an unknown URL.
Step 2: HTTP 200 OK — password sign-in is unaffected.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A build with Authentication:Google:Enabled = false, prepared by QA lead.
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh exchanges the cookie for a new session and retires the old cookie.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with header Cookie: tc_refresh_token=<value from step 1> and no body.
Within 60 seconds send POST /api/auth/refresh again with the cookie from step 1 (not the new one).
expected: Step 2: HTTP 200 OK, same body shape as login, a new "accessToken" and a new tc_refresh_token value.
Step 3: HTTP 401, body code "MSG01": a refresh token works only once.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh without the cookie answers like an expired session.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/refresh with no Cookie header and no body.
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Body: { "code": "MSG01", "message": "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại." }
Set-Cookie: tc_refresh_token=; max-age=0; path=/api/auth (cookie cleared).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh ignores a refresh token sent in the body.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with no Cookie header; Headers: Content-Type: application/json; Body: { "refreshToken": "<cookie value from step 1>" }.
expected: HTTP 401, body code "MSG01": the refresh token is read only from the cookie.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify replaying a used refresh token after 60 seconds ends every session of the account.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie. Call the cookie RT1.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with RT1; call the new cookie RT2.
Wait more than 60 seconds.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with RT1 again.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with RT2.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 200 OK.
Step 4: HTTP 401, code "MSG01" (reuse detected).
Step 5: HTTP 401, code "MSG01": the session continued with RT2 has ended too, so whoever stole RT1 keeps nothing.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh ends the session of an account deactivated meanwhile.
procedure: Sign in as the disposable account with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
As Admin, deactivate the account (UC-06c).
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with the cookie from step 1.
expected: HTTP 401, body { "code": "MSG02", "message": "Tài khoản không khả dụng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." }.
Set-Cookie: tc_refresh_token=; max-age=0; path=/api/auth (cookie cleared).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Disposable active account and an Admin account, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify a capability change reaches the user at the next refresh without signing in again.
procedure: Sign in as the disposable account with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
As Admin, remove one capability from the account's role (UC-11).
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with the cookie from step 1.
expected: HTTP 200 OK; "user.capabilities" no longer contains the removed capability.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Disposable role with at least one capability and an account in it, supplied by QA lead; restore the role afterwards.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/refresh is not rate limited.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Within one minute send POST /api/auth/refresh 10 times, each with the cookie returned by the previous call.
expected: Every call: HTTP 200 OK, never 429.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Sign-in rate limits at their defaults (test server): 5 attempts per minute per email, 60 per minute per IP.
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/logout ends the session on the server and clears the cookie.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send POST /api/auth/logout with Cookie: tc_refresh_token=<value from step 1>.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with the same cookie.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 204 No Content; Set-Cookie: tc_refresh_token=; max-age=0; path=/api/auth (cookie cleared).
Step 3: HTTP 401, code "MSG01": the refresh token was revoked on the server, not only removed from the browser.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/auth/logout always answers 204, even without a valid session.
procedure: Send POST /api/auth/logout with no cookie.
Send it again with Cookie: tc_refresh_token=khonghople.
expected: Both: HTTP 204 No Content with the cookie-clearing Set-Cookie header; nothing reveals whether a session existed.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).

cases.description: Verify signing out on one device leaves the other devices signed in.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary twice with two separate POST /api/auth/login calls; keep cookie A and cookie B.
Send POST /api/auth/logout with cookie A.
Send POST /api/auth/refresh with cookie B.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 204.
Step 3: HTTP 200 OK: only session A ended.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me returns the signed-in user.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
Send GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK, body { "id", "email", "fullName", "roleId", "roleName", "capabilities" } for the Secretary.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me rejects a missing or forged token.
procedure: Send GET /api/auth/me with no Authorization header.
Send it with Authorization: Bearer <a valid accessToken with one character of its signature changed>.
expected: Both: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Secretary account supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me refuses a still-valid access token once the account is deactivated.
procedure: Sign in as the disposable account with POST /api/auth/login; keep the accessToken and the tc_refresh_token cookie.
As Admin, deactivate the account.
Within 15 minutes of step 1, send GET /api/auth/me with the accessToken from step 1.
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (not 403): the account status is read from the database on every request, not from the token.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Disposable active account and an Admin account, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/auth/me refuses a Guest access token.
procedure: Send GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <Guest access token>.
expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized: a Guest token never opens an internal endpoint.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.
A Guest access token from a successful POST .../verify for this invitation.

cases.description: Verify opening a valid invitation shows the meeting and a masked email.
procedure: From the invitation link <base>/guest/{invitationId}#token={linkToken}, note invitationId and linkToken.
Send POST /api/guest-access/invitations/{invitationId}
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "token": "<linkToken>" }
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body: { "invitationId", "meeting": { "id", "title", "status": "Published", "plannedStartTime", "plannedEndTime" }, "maskedEmail" } where maskedEmail hides most of the local part.
This call sends no code: the Guest inbox receives nothing new.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.

cases.description: Verify an invitation opened with a wrong link token is refused without a reason.
procedure: Send POST /api/guest-access/invitations/{invitationId} with Body: { "token": "saitoken" }.
Send it with a random invitationId and the real linkToken.
expected: Both: HTTP 404, body { "code": "MSG371", "message": "Lời mời không còn hiệu lực. Vui lòng liên hệ Thư ký cuộc họp." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.

cases.description: Verify the invitation of a meeting that is no longer open is refused.
procedure: Have the Chair end the meeting (UC-22) or the Secretary cancel it (UC-75).
Send POST /api/guest-access/invitations/{invitationId} with the real linkToken.
expected: HTTP 404, body code "MSG371" — the same answer as a wrong token.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived. Use a disposable meeting.

cases.description: Verify a revoked invitation is refused.
procedure: As Secretary, remove the Guest from the participants (UC-28c).
Send POST /api/guest-access/invitations/{invitationId} with the real linkToken.
expected: HTTP 404, body code "MSG371".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.

cases.description: Verify requesting a code sends a 6-digit code to the invited email only.
procedure: From the invitation link <base>/guest/{invitationId}#token={linkToken}, note invitationId and linkToken.
Send POST /api/guest-access/invitations/{invitationId}/code
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "token": "<linkToken>" }
expected: HTTP 200 OK, body { "code": "MSG375", "message": "Đã gửi mã xác minh tới email được mời.", "expiresInSeconds": 900, "resendAfterSeconds": 60 }.
The invited inbox receives one email with a 6-digit code; the body cannot redirect it to another address.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.

cases.description: Verify a second code request within 1 minute is refused with a countdown.
procedure: Send POST .../code.
Within 60 seconds send POST .../code again.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 429, header Retry-After, body { "code": "MSG373", "message": "Vui lòng chờ trước khi gửi lại mã.", "retryAfterSeconds": n } with 0 < n ≤ 60.
No second email arrives.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.

cases.description: Verify a new code sent after 1 minute retires the previous one.
procedure: Send POST .../code; note code C1 from the inbox.
After 60 seconds send POST .../code again; note code C2.
Send POST .../verify with C1.
Send POST .../verify with C2.
expected: Step 2: HTTP 200, code "MSG375".
Step 3: HTTP 400, code "MSG126" (not counted as a wrong attempt).
Step 4: HTTP 200 with an "accessToken".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.

cases.description: Verify an invitation receives at most 20 codes in 24 hours.
procedure: Request codes 1 minute apart until 20 have been sent within 24 hours.
After one more minute send POST .../code again.
expected: HTTP 429, header Retry-After, body { "code": "MSG379", "message": "Bạn đã yêu cầu quá số mã cho phép trong 24 giờ. Vui lòng thử lại sau hoặc liên hệ Thư ký cuộc họp.", "retryAfterSeconds": n }, n = time until the oldest code leaves the 24-hour window.
No email is sent.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived. Use a disposable invitation.

cases.description: Verify a failed email delivery keeps no code and allows an immediate retry.
procedure: Send POST .../code while email delivery is broken.
Restore email delivery and immediately send POST .../code again.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 503, body { "code": "MSG374", "message": "Không thể xác minh lúc này. Vui lòng thử lại sau." }.
Step 2: HTTP 200, code "MSG375", without the 1-minute wait; the email arrives.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.
QA lead can break email delivery on the build (wrong SMTP setting) and restore it.

cases.description: Verify the right code opens a Guest session.
procedure: From the invitation link <base>/guest/{invitationId}#token={linkToken}, note invitationId and linkToken.
Send POST /api/guest-access/invitations/{invitationId}/verify
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "token": "<linkToken>", "code": "<6-digit code>" }
expected: HTTP 200 OK, body { "accessToken", "expiresAt" (12 hours ahead), "meetingId" (the invited meeting), "profileCompleted": false }.
GET /api/guest-access/session with the token answers 200.
No internal user account is created for the Guest (user list unchanged).
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.
A code has been requested for the invitation (POST .../code) and the 6-digit code read from the Guest inbox.

cases.description: Verify a wrong code is refused.
procedure: Send POST .../verify with { "token": "<linkToken>", "code": "<6 digits other than the code>" }.
expected: HTTP 400, body { "code": "MSG126", "message": "Không xác minh được lời mời. Vui lòng kiểm tra mã và thử lại." }.
No session is created.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.
A code has been requested for the invitation (POST .../code) and the 6-digit code read from the Guest inbox.

cases.description: Verify a code that is not 6 digits is refused.
procedure: Send POST .../verify with "code": "12ab".
Send it with "code": "1234567".
expected: Both: HTTP 400, body code "MSG126".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A Secretary has invited an external Guest (name + email of a controlled inbox) to a Published meeting (UC-28a); the invitation email has arrived.
